blocks.text: Structural isomerism sirf hydrocarbons nahi, organic compounds ki sab qismein aur un ke derivatives dikhate hain; yeh molecule ke andar atoms ki tarteeb ke farq se paida hoti hai aur paanch tarah se zahir hoti hai.

items: Chain isomerism carbon zanjeer ki nau'iyat ke farq se paida hoti hai: C4H10 ke liye butane aur 2-methylpropane (isobutane); C5H12 ke liye pentane, 2-methylbutane (isopentane) aur 2,2-dimethylpropane (neopentane).
Position isomerism ek hi functional group ki be-tabdeel carbon zanjeer par jagah ke farq se paida hoti hai: 1-chloropropane aur 2-chloropropane; but-1-ene aur but-2-ene (C4H8).
Functional group isomerism: ek jaise molecular formula magar mukhtalif functional groups wale compounds, jaise methoxymethane CH3OCH3 aur ethanol CH3CH2OH (C2H6O).

Metamerism ek hi homologous series ke compounds mein functional group ke dono taraf carbon atoms ki na-barabar taqseem se paida hoti hai: ethoxyethane CH3CH2OCH2CH3 aur methoxypropane CH3OCH2CH2CH3; ketone C5H10O ke liye pentan-3-one CH3CH2COCH2CH3 aur pentan-2-one CH3COCH2CH2CH3.

Tautomerism ek hi molecule mein proton ke ek atom se doosre par sarakne se paida hoti hai, aam taur par amino acids mein, jo zwitterions ke taur par maujood hain jo carboxylic acid sire se amine group tak proton sarakne par bante hain: RCH(NH2)COOH aur RCH(NH3+)COO-.

blocks.text: Stereoisomers ka structural formula ek jaisa hai magar space mein ek jaise groups ki jagahon mein farq hai. Is ki do qismein hain, geometrical (cis-trans) isomerism aur optical isomerism; yeh Class XII ke nisab ka hissa hain.

blocks.caption: Isomerism ki qismein
rows: functional group ke har taraf carbons

blocks.prompt: C4H8 ka position isomerism dikhane wala isomer batayein, ethoxymethane aur propanol kis qism ke isomers hain, aur alkenes mein mumkin structural isomerism ginwayein (Quick Check 11.9a se c).
blocks.explanation: But-1-ene CH2=CHCH2CH3 aur but-2-ene CH3CH=CHCH3 C4H8 ke position isomers hain. Ethoxymethane CH3CH2OCH3 aur propan-1-ol CH3CH2CH2OH dono C3H8O hain mukhtalif functional groups (ether aur alcohol) ke saath: functional group isomers. Alkenes chain isomerism (but-1-ene aur 2-methylpropene), position isomerism (but-1-ene aur but-2-ene) aur cycloalkanes ke saath functional group isomerism (but-1-ene aur cyclobutane) dikha sakte hain.

items: Structural isomerism: chain (butane / isobutane), position (1- / 2-chloropropane, but-1-ene / but-2-ene), functional group (ethanol / methoxymethane), metamerism (ethoxyethane / methoxypropane, pentan-2-one / pentan-3-one), tautomerism (amino acid / zwitterion).
Stereoisomerism: ek structure, space mein mukhtalif tarteeb; geometrical (cis-trans) aur optical, Class XII mein.
